visibleTurns.text: Moment Diary Backend MVP 交付完成。核心功能实现 认证系统：支持 /auth/register 和 /auth/login。使用 Bun.password 进行安全哈希，并基于 SQLite 的 sessions 表实现 Bearer Token 认证。 日记 CRUD：  POST /diaries：创建带标题、内容、心情和标签的日记。支持标签数组输入，并实现了用户内标签按小写去重（normalized_name）。  GET /diaries & GET /diaries/:id：读取用户自己的日记，包含关联标签。  PATCH /diaries/:id：更新日记内容、心情或标签，并自动刷新 updated_at。  DELETE /diaries/:id：删除日记并自动通过外键级联（ON DELETE CASCADE）清理关联标签关系。 时间轴 API：GET /timeline 支持按 tag、mood 筛选，并提供分页（limit 默认 20，offset），按 created_at 倒序排列。 安全性与完整性：所有受保护接口均校验 Bearer Token 及其对应的 Ownership，防止越权访问。数据库开启 WAL 模式和外键约束。 工程化：代码结构清晰（Router/Service 模式），包含全量单元测试与集成测试，已通过 tsc --noEmit 类型检查。运行与测试  启动应用：bun start  运行测试：bun test  数据文件：data/moment-diary.db (自动创建)
交付 (已交付)Delivery finalized with 3 exported artifacts.

✅ 评估：通过分类：evaluationThe implementation completely fulfills the requirements for the Moment Diary Backend MVP. All 9 specified test scenarios were confirmed via source code and test file reviews. The system implements a secure authentication layer, full diary CRUD with tag management (including deduplication and cascading cleanup), and a robust timeline filtering system. Code is modular and follows the requested file structure.检查项✓ spec_check: The implementation fulfills all the requirements specified in the MVP brief.Data Models & Database: SQLite is correctly initialized with the specified schema (users, sessions, diary_entries, tags, diary_tags) including foreign key constraints and ON DELETE CASCADE for tag cleanup.Authentication: Secure password hashing via Bun.password and session management via a random token in the database are implemented. Unauthorized access is prevented via middleware.Diary API: All CRUD operations are present. Ownership checks are strictly enforced (entries can only be accessed/modified by their owners). Tags are deduplicated using normalized_name within the user scope. updated_at is refreshed on PATCH.Timeline API: Supports filtering by tag (normalized) and mood, with pagination (limit/offset) and DESC sorting by created_at.Tests: Comprehensive tests cover password security, session management, CRUD operations, ownership isolation, filtering logic, and cascading deletion.Technical Constraints: Uses Bun, Hono, and bun:sqlite.
